sayLines.text: 💛 You hold Reading Glasses. You read the fine print on medicine bottles for Gabriel next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon.
